target.title: fix(cli): reduce plugin hook fallback noise
target.body:
Related: #78388

## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where a failed plugin installation would append `Also not a valid hook pack` when the same package simply had no hook-pack manifest. The extra suffix was expected during plugin-to-hook fallback and obscured the useful plugin error.

## Why This Change Was Made

Hook installation now returns stable structured codes for missing and empty hook manifests. Plugin installation suppresses the fallback suffix only for the expected missing-manifest case; malformed or incomplete hook packs still retain their actionable fallback error.

This is a corrected maintainer replay of #78388. The original patch matched an error message that the runtime prefixes with `Error:`, so it would not suppress the noise reliably.

## User Impact

Failed plugin installs show the relevant plugin error without a misleading hook-pack diagnosis. Real hook-pack failures such as a missing `HOOK.md` remain visible.

## Evidence

- Blacksmith Testbox focused proof: 183 tests passed across `src/hooks/install.test.ts` and the plugin CLI install suites.
- Fresh autoreview: no accepted or actionable findings.
- `git diff --check` clean.
- Exact-head GitHub Actions required before merge.

Contributor credit is preserved via the commit co-author and changelog thanks to @vincentkoc.
